text:
alex: scheduling change window today 09:00 PST to enable model rex-v2-lite in catalog. plan: phased 10% -> 25% -> 100% over ~3h. Need latency-floor checks and fallback ordering verification before final stage. Pin policy: keep rex-v1 as explicit fallback. @simon can you confirm the fallback ladder and pin commands?

deploy-bot: scheduled catalog change created by alex. change-window: 2026-04-05T09:00:00-08:00. automated checks: observability, canary, safety-gates.

simon: quick notes: I'll set fallback order to [rex-v2-lite, rex-v1, quant-rex]. if rex-v2-lite errors or p95 spikes > 300ms, route back to rex-v1 and demote rex-v2-lite. pin command and enable snippet below: 

```bash
rwctl catalog pin set --model rex-v1 --reason "fallback default during rex-v2-lite enable"
rwctl catalog enable --model rex-v2-lite --percent 10
```

maya: what are the concrete rollback triggers? thresholds? :eyes:

simon: rollback triggers (summary):
- error-rate increase >= 2.5x baseline sustained for >5m
- correctness/regression checks on sample evals drop below 97%
- p95 latency increase >250ms absolute or >40% relative for >10m
If any trigger fires, automated policy shifts traffic to rex-v1 for the affected region and alerts runtime-oncall.

elena-pm: release notes: no user-visible behavior change, internal model variant swap only. I'll add a note referencing QA run QA-782 and the model tag rex-v2-lite-20260405.

runtime-oncall: I'll watch the SLO dashboards (p50/p95/error-rate). please tag me when you start the canary and hold the final stage until I ack.

alex: agreed — hold final stage until runtime-oncall ack. abort if observability gating fails. I'll post start/finish stamps in this thread. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: change started by alex at 2091122390

simon: canary 10% report after 18m: p50/p95 within expected floor, no error increase, sample evals pass. holding at 25% for 20m per rollout plan.

runtime-oncall: ack, metrics stable and no anomaly in traces. you can proceed to 25% -> 100% per schedule.

alex: proceeding with staged ramp to 100% over remaining window. will pause if anything degrades.

deploy-bot: change completed at 2091122599 — rex-v2-lite rolled to 100% with fallback ladder set. logs: https://console.internal/runs/2091122334

alex: closing thread. thanks everyone for the quick checks and watchfulness.
